content_sections.heading: NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 28 years as on the date of the walk-in interview . This is relaxable for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and OBC categories as per Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: The Fellowship shall initially be awarded for a period of two years (extendable as per rules), with a monthly emolument of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible under the rules.

content_sections.heading: NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made through a walk-in interview conducted on the notified date and time. Candidates must produce all original certificates/testimonials/community certificate/valid GATE/NET score card, along with a set of self-attested copies and an ID proof, at the time of the interview. A panel will be drawn from the interview for the vacancies available and future vacancies, and this panel will operate for a period of one year. Empanelment does not, by itself, entitle a candidate to an offer of Fellowship; this is contingent on the occurrence of vacancies during the year. The Director, NPOL, reserves the right not to select any candidate if suitable candidates are not available.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview Process)
content_sections.text: There is no online application for this recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates may directly appear for the walk-in interview as per the process below: Report on 10.10.2026 (Saturday) at 0930 hrs at Bhavan's Varuna Vidyalaya, in the campus of Naval Physical & Oceanographic Laboratory, Thrikkakara P.O., Kochi – 682021. Carry all original certificates and testimonials, community certificate (if applicable), and valid GATE/NET score card. Bring a set of self-attested copies of all testimonials/certificates. Carry an original ID proof (Voter's ID/Aadhaar card/PAN card/Driving License). Bring one recent colour passport-size photograph. Optionally, prospective candidates may e-mail a one-page bio-data to [email protected] in advance, to help with necessary administrative arrangements.

faq.question: Q1. What is NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory (NPOL), DRDO, Ministry of Defence, to select Junior Research Fellows (JRF) across seven disciplines, vide Advertisement No. NPOL/JRF/01/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Vacancies are marked as "Anticipated" for most disciplines, meaning the exact number has not been fixed. Only Mechanical Engineering has a specified number of 4 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application or last date to apply, as selection is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 10.10.2026 (Saturday) at 0930 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by discipline and generally requires a B.E/B.Tech (with valid GATE) or M.E/M.Tech/PG degree (at Graduate and Post Graduate level) in 1st Division in the relevant field, as detailed in the vacancy table.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, relaxable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application process. Eligible candidates should directly attend the walk-in interview on 10.10.2026 at Bhavan's Varuna Vidyalaya, in the NPOL campus, Thrikkakara P.O., Kochi – 682021, with all required original documents.
